newsitem.title: INDIA: India to allow foreign equity in forex broking.
newsitem.headline: India to allow foreign equity in forex broking.

text.p: India will allow foreign equity participation in foreign exchange broking in addition to 14 non-banking financial services in which foreign equity was allowed earlier this year, the Finance Ministry said on Friday.

India in March allowed foreign equity participation in 14 financial services including merchant banking, underwriting, portfolio management services, financial consultancy, stockbroking, asset management, venture capital firms, and credit rating agencies.
"It has since been decided to include forex broking in the list of activities opened to foreign investors," the ministry said in a statement.

"The guidelines applicable for considering proposals of foreign equity participation in non-banking financial companies would be equally applicable for foreign equity participation in forex broking," the statement said.
